hints.title: Structure of All-Set Numbers
hints.text: Observe that any number whose binary representation contains only ones has the mathematical form 2^k - 1.

hints.title: Bit Length Determination
hints.text: Find how many bits are required to represent n in binary.

hints.title: Mask Construction
hints.text: Shift 1 left by that bit count and subtract 1 to get the smallest all-set number greater than or equal to n.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Computes the bit length of n and constructs (1 << bit_length) - 1.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Sequential testing is slower than direct bitwise calculation.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognizes that numbers with all set bits are of the form 2^k - 1.
